options.content: Each row below is one trace: **write** (the domain transaction's `TandemContext` span) → **outbox dwell** (the gap between the write span ending and the publish span starting — there is no span for this, it is what the gap itself shows) → **`tandem.relay.publish`** (the real Kafka send) → **consume** (the benchmark's own consumer span). Click a row's **Trace ID** to open its waterfall. To find every trace belonging to one simulated business operation, run `{span.tandem.correlation_id="biz-<aggregate>"}` in Explore → Tempo — the same value the demo prints for `tandem outbox search --correlation-id`.
